summary: POST /api/promo/validate returns HTTP 500 internal error for expired promo code
preconditions: API server is running at http://localhost:3000
steps_to_reproduce: Send a POST request to http://localhost:3000/api/promo/validate
expected_result: Graceful 4xx rejection (e.g. HTTP 400 with a clear invalid-code message).
actual_result: Server returns HTTP 500 Internal Server Error instead of a graceful rejection.
